act.long_title: An Act to consolidate and amend the provisions relating to offences and for matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.

classification.offence: Deliberate and malicious acts, intended to outrage religious feelings of any class by insulting its religion or religious beliefs.
classification.punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years, or fine, or both.

licence: Published with commentary and other original matter under s.52(1)(q)(ii), Copyright Act 1957.

section.heading: Deliberate and malicious acts, intended to outrage religious feelings of any class by insulting its religion or religious beliefs
section.html: Whoever, with deliberate and malicious intention of outraging the religious feelings of any class of citizens of India, by words, either spoken or written, or by signs or by visible representations or through electronic means or otherwise, insults or attempts to insult the religion or the religious beliefs of that class, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to three years, or with fine, or with both.
